text_en: From there Abraham journeyed toward the region of the Negeb, and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While residing in Gerar as an alien,
text_cn: 亚巴郎从那里迁往乃革布地，定居在卡德士和叔尔之间。当他住在革辣尔时，

text_en: Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister. ” And King Abimelech of Gerar sent and took Sarah.
text_cn: 亚巴郎一论到他的妻子撒辣就说：“她是我的妹妹。”革辣尔王阿彼默肋客于是派人来娶了撒辣去。

text_en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, “You are about to die because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a married woman. ”
text_cn: 但是夜间，天主在梦中来对阿彼默肋客说：“为了你娶来的那个女人你该死，因为她原是有夫之妇。”

text_en: Now Abimelech had not approached her; so he said, “Lord, will you destroy an innocent people?
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客尚未接近她，于是说：“我主！连正义的人你也杀害吗？

text_en: Did he not himself say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother. ’ I did this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands. ”
text_cn: 那男人不是对我说过‘她是我的妹妹’吗？连她自己也说‘他是我的哥哥’。我做了这事，是出于心正手洁呀！”

text_en: Then God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart; furthermore it was I who kept you from sinning against me. Therefore I did not let you touch her.
text_cn: 天主在梦中对他说：“我也知道，你是出于心正做了这事，所以我阻止了你犯罪得罪我，也没有让你接触她。

text_en: Now then, return the man’s wife; for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you shall live. But if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you and all that are yours. ”
text_cn: 现在你应将女人还给那人，因为他是一位先知，他要为你转求，你才可生存；倘若你不归还，你该知道：你以及凡属于你的，必死无疑。”

text_en: So Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants and told them all these things; and the men were very much afraid.
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客很早就起来召集了众臣仆，将全部实情告诉给他们听；这些人都很害怕。

text_en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought such great guilt on me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that ought not to be done. ”
text_cn: 然后阿彼默肋客叫了亚巴郎来，对他说：“你对我们作的是什么事？我在什么事上得罪了你，竟给我和我的王国招来了这样大的罪过？你对我作了不应该作的事。”

text_en: And Abimelech said to Abraham, “What were you thinking of, that you did this thing? ”
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客继而对亚巴郎说：“你作这事，究有什么意思？”

text_en: Abraham said, “I did it because I thought, There is no fear of God at all in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.
text_cn: 亚巴郎答说：“我以为在这地方一定没有人敬畏天主，人会为了我妻子的缘故杀害我。

text_en: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
text_cn: 何况她实在是我的妹妹，虽不是我母亲的女儿，却是我父亲的女儿；后来做了我的妻子。

text_en: And when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is the kindness you must do me: at every place to which we come, say of me, He is my brother. ’”
text_cn: 当天主叫我离开父家，在外飘流的时候，我对她说：我们无论到什么地方，你要说我是你的哥哥，这就是你待我的大恩。”

text_en: Then Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and male and female slaves, and gave them to Abraham, and restored his wife Sarah to him.
text_cn: 阿彼默肋客把些牛羊奴婢，送给了亚巴郎，也将他的妻子撒辣归还了他；

text_en: Abimelech said, “My land is before you; settle where it pleases you. ”
text_cn: 然后对他说：“看，我的土地尽在你面前，你愿住在哪里，就住在哪里。”

text_en: To Sarah he said, “Look, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver; it is your exoneration before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated. ”
text_cn: 继而对撒辣说：“看，我给了你哥哥一千银子，作为你在阖家人前的遮羞钱；这样，各方面无可指摘。”

text_en: Then Abraham prayed to God; and God healed Abimelech, and also healed his wife and female slaves so that they bore children.
text_cn: 亚巴郎恳求了天主，天主就医好了阿彼默肋客，他的妻子和他的众婢女，使她们都能生育，

text_en: For the Lord had closed fast all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
text_cn: 因为上主为了亚巴郎妻子撒辣的事，关闭了阿彼默肋客家中所有妇女的子宫。
